signal: Prove launched its Identity Platform in April 2026, repositioning identity as a continuous trust layer for people, businesses and AI agents

email.body1:
Heidi, saw Prove launched the Identity Platform, repositioning identity as a continuous trust layer for people, businesses, and AI agents.

A launch that broad usually opens more in-market enterprise accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Heidi, quick follow-up for Prove.

A platform launch usually expands the enterprise target list faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove's enterprise team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Heidi, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other identity and security teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Heidi, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a platform launch, timing is everything, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise security motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
